messages:
Aisha Malik: :wave: FYI - Velara (new customer) completed the SSO invite and the Console shows 'Provisioning complete', but they never received an API key. Customer reports 403 when hitting our API with SDK; console shows no key under the project. Need help triaging — they go live tomorrow morning.

Tom Chen: Can you paste the org/project IDs and the exact error the customer sees? Also any provisioning logs from the onboarding job.

Aisha Malik: Org: velara-inc, Project: velara-prod. Customer SDK error (curl):

curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generation \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-<redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "redwood-4b", "prompt": "hi"}'

Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": {
    "message": "API key not found or not authorized for project velara-prod",
    "code": "forbidden"
  }
}

Aisha Malik: I also pulled the onboarding job output from the console (pasted below). Looks like the workflow completed but the KeyCreate step returned a soft error.

Onboard Bot: Automated provisioning log for job 0ab9c3e:
```
2026-11-18T09:12:03Z INFO starting onboarding workflow for org=velara-inc, project=velara-prod
2026-11-18T09:12:09Z INFO creating project resources
2026-11-18T09:12:12Z INFO service-account create -> sa-velara-prod
2026-11-18T09:12:18Z INFO attempting API key creation
2026-11-18T09:12:18Z ERROR APIKeyCreate failed: target_project_tag mismatch (expected velara-prod, found default)
2026-11-18T09:12:18Z WARN continuing workflow with partial provisioning
2026-11-18T09:12:20Z INFO provisioning complete with warnings
```

Priya Patel: Hmm, that message suggests the key did get created but tagged under the wrong project (`default`). Ops, can you confirm whether an API key exists under the org with a different project tag?

Ops Bot: Found 1 key for org=velara-inc:
```
key_id: key_7f1b2a
created_by: onboard-service
project_tag: default
scopes: [generation, embeddings]
status: active
```

Ops Bot: The key exists but it's not attached to velara-prod. Our auth layer checks project_tag for request scoping, so it rejects calls labelled as velara-prod when the key is tagged `default`.

Tom Chen: That explains the 403. Two possible remediation paths: 1) re-run the provisioning with the corrected mapping so the key is created with the right project_tag, or 2) manually re-tag the existing key to velara-prod (fast) and notify the customer. We need to check audit logs to confirm why project_tag defaulted.

Aisha Malik: Customer needs something now — can we do manual retagging? Are there security implications? Priya, can Support perform manual retag or do we need SRE?

Priya Patel: Support cannot edit key metadata. SRE/ops can. Manual retag is safe if we preserve created_by and scopes; just update project_tag. We should also add an ACL entry so only onboard-service or SRE can change tags. I'll document the step.

Tom Chen: I'll run a quick check on the onboard-service mapping logic. Likely a race between SCIM group sync and project creation: if project creation returns late we fall back to `default` tag. Will push a fix to ensure atomic project_tag assignment or set a retry on key creation.

Aisha Malik: OK please do the manual retag for now — customer is blocked. Priya, can you coordinate with SRE and confirm once done? I'll tell Velara to expect a follow-up and a temporary key.

Onboard Bot: Running manual retag script as requested by Tom Chen and Priya Patel. Command:
```
redwood-admin keys update --key-id key_7f1b2a --project-tag velara-prod --requested-by tom.chen
```

Ops Bot: Retag completed: key_7f1b2a project_tag updated to velara-prod. Audit entry id: audit_33f9. Manual change performed by ops-oncall.

Aisha Malik: I provided the customer with a fresh key payload and they tested. SDK call now returns 200 and generation works. :tada:

Velara test (redacted):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "id": "gen_01", "output": "hi" }
```

Priya Patel: Follow-ups: 1) Tom to open a bug for onboarding race condition + ensure retry/atomic tag, 2) SRE to add stricter validation so onboarding logs surface key tagging mismatch as failure instead of warning, 3) Ops to add a runbook for manual key retagging during high-priority onboards. I'll create a short KB entry for Support to use for now.

Tom Chen: Filed issue INFRA-4127 for the race condition and INFRA-4128 for better onboarding validations. Will target patch for the next minor release.

Aisha Malik: Marking this P1 until KB is posted and customer confirms stability. I'll close thread after KB link and customer confirmation.Thanks everyone. :heart:
